title: NEW condo near Vandy - minutes to Broadway!
description:
Enjoy a fabulous experience at this new 2 bedroom condo in a perfect location!  Near Centennial Park- walking distance to West End and any Vandy events, and a 5 min Uber ride down the street to Broadway!  Great location, great amenities (on site gym and outdoor pool), and fully stocked and ready for your stay.  Expect comfortable and stylish furnishings, an attentive host, and a safe location.  Truly a great place to stay for your Nashville experience!  STRP #2023080573

The space
New condo, clean, safe.  Two bedrooms (1 king bed, 1 queen bed) with 2 full bathrooms and a queen sleeper sofa.  Island with seating and kitchen table for 6.  Several Great restaurants and beautiful Centennial park within walking distance.

Guest access
All access is electronic- smart access into building and unit.  Also, you have access to a full fitness center and an outdoor pool.
